info.name: Veeam Backup for AWS public API 1.0 Agents Backups API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of backups to return.

params.name: orderColumn
params.description: Sorts backups by one of the backup parameters.

params.name: orderAsc
params.description: Sorts backups in the ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

params.name: nameFilter
params.description: Filters backups by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any backup parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

params.name: createdAfterFilter
params.description: Returns backups that are created after the specified date and time.

params.name: createdBeforeFilter
params.description: Returns backups that are created before the specified date and time.

params.name: platformIdFilter
params.description: Filters backups by ID of the backup object platform.

params.name: jobIdFilter
params.description: Filters backups by ID of the parent job.

params.name: policyTagFilter
params.description: Filters backups by retention policy tag.

items.docs: The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backups` path allows you to get an array of all backups that are created on or imported to the backup server.
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backups/{id}` path allows you to get a backup that has the specified `id`.

The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backups/{id}/objects` path allows you to get an array of virtual infrastructure objects (VMs and VM containers) that are included in a backup that has the specified ID.
